verse.text: And you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children. We pleaded with you, encouraged you, and urged you to live your lives in a way that God would consider worthy. For he called you to share in his Kingdom and glory.

video.title: #TellThemNow - The Father's Day Video That Will Melt Your Heart

reflection: Paul says he treated believers 'as a father treats his own children' — not with harsh commands, but with pleading, encouragement, and urging toward a worthy life. That's the daily work of fatherhood: fewer lectures, more patient coaching, showing up again tomorrow even after today's failures. Your kids won't remember every rule you set, but they'll remember whether you kept encouraging them toward the good even when it was hard.
